# Nuka World on Tour: New Food and Drinks Guide

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Nov 23, 2022
- 7 min read

Updated: Apr 11, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_91ab9a02d613426b8c72906648363663~mv2.jpg)

The Nuka World on Tour DLC brings 12 new food items, 9 new recipes and 1 new Nuka Cola flavour.

Most of the food items can be purchased from Betty, the Ghoul NPC. Her trailer can be found next to the Tunnel of Love entrance.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e4ab6262056d436d9dd0386c1a1f4428~mv2.jpg)

The new recipes drop from the Tunnel of Love event and are tradeable.

A checklist of all plans can be found __here__.

**Nuka-Cola Candy & Nuka-Quantum Candy**

### **__Drinks__**

__Drinks__

__Nuka-Cola Twist__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_53ae62f2a2884118b39b1cdb0a147ddf~mv2.jpg)

**Buffs**

Upon consumption, the player will recieve 1 of 7 possible SPECIAL buffs that last for 10 mins.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d2370592349f434695c5b910e7befcf0~mv2.png)

Note: Nuka Twist will stack, but not on the same buffs. For example the strength buff and the strength buff will not stack, but Strength, Intelligence and Perception will. You will need to have Cola Nut (Endurance perk card) equipped in order for Nuka Twist to stack.

Cola Nut Rank 1 allows the player to have two Nuka Twist buffs running and Cola Nut Rank 2 allows the player to have three Nuka Twist buffs running.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_3c94fb8f5ed44456a1a29c460ffd1c11~mv2.jpg)

**Recipe location**

N/A

**Pre-made - Vendor**

Nuka-Cola Vending Machine (Nuka World in the Ash Heap)

The vending machines can be found behind the Nuka-Cade. While there are 5 machines in total, they all share the same inventory. You will need to purchase what you need and then server hop again to refresh the inventory.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_34b049d192514187a07bb59df4331fb6~mv2.jpg)
